step1.title: Welcome to LV Floorball Fantasy
step1.bullet1: Build your squad and compete every matchweek.
step1.bullet2: Earn points from real player performances.
step1.bullet3: Track rank, budget, and transfers in one place.

step2.title: Build your squad
step2.text: Build within 90 credits. Roster: 4A / 2D / 1G / 1 FLEX. Captain gives 2× points.

step4.title: Gameweeks & points
step4.text:
Gameweeks follow the real calendar (Mon–Sun, Latvia time).

Every match played within that week contributes to your total points.

If a week has no fixtures, its number may simply be skipped.

step1.title: Player details
step1.body: Tap a player to see form and last 5 matches.

step2.title: Team points
step2.body: Tap the squad to view your points breakdown.

step3.title: Transfers
step3.body: Use transfers to swap players and manage budget.

step4.title: Captain
step4.body: Pick a captain for 2× points (change once every 30 days).

step5.title: Locks
step5.body: Players lock on match days and can’t be transferred.
